One timesheet, two densities

Fill a day or a whole week on the same surface, from the keyboard. A timer sits in the bar on every screen.

Approvals that show what changed

People submit a week and can still fix it; approvers see exactly what changed since, then close the period.

Rates that stay true

Billable and cost rates by person, task and project, with history. A past entry keeps the price it was recorded at.

Reports you can export

Time, budgets, utilization and profitability, by any column you choose, as CSV whenever you want.

Bring your history

Import a Harvest account with your own token. You read a reconciliation of every month before anything is committed.
